No Ability.note: The Mezepheles once someone has turned evil.

Turns Evil.note: The first good player to say the secret word, who may be the Mezepheles if it is good.

setupPrep.none: its tokens are only used after the first night or when something happens

reminderMovement.why: Only the first player to say the word turns evil.

reminderPlaceholders.note: The player who said the word turns evil; the Mezepheles' ability is used.

full.text: If a good player said the secret word today (*TURNS EVIL*), wake them, show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumbs-down: they are now evil. Remove *TURNS EVIL* and mark the Mezepheles *NO ABILITY*.
full.reason: Says when the Turns Evil token comes off and the ability is used.
